# Python2

> [!WARNING]
> This mod is deprecated: This mod is deprecated since Python2 is EOL.

This mod adds a python2 dev environment to code-server, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `code-server` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-python2
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:code-server-python2|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/code-server-python2/
